Bourbon.name: Buffalo Trace
Bourbon.description: Kentucky straight bourbon from Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort. Mash bill includes corn, rye, and malted barley. Aged in new oak barrels. Vanilla, caramel, and mint notes. 90 proof.

London dry gin.name: Tanqueray London Dry
London dry gin.description: London dry gin from Charles Tanqueray & Co. Distilled with juniper, coriander, angelica root, and liquorice. Four-time distilled. Crisp juniper-forward profile with citrus and spice. 43.1% ABV.

Rye whiskey.name: Rittenhouse Rye
Rye whiskey.description: Bottled-in-bond rye whiskey from Heaven Hill Distillery. 100 proof. Bold spice, pepper, and baking spice character with a robust finish. The benchmark for stirred whiskey cocktails.

Aged rum.name: Diplomático Reserva Exclusiva
Aged rum.description: Venezuelan aged rum from Diplomático. Blended from rums aged up to 8 years. Rich molasses, caramel, and vanilla with dried fruit. Smooth enough for sipping; complex enough for cocktails.

Sweet vermouth.name: Carpano Antica Formula
Sweet vermouth.description: Premium Italian sweet vermouth from Fratelli Branca. First vermouth created by Antonio Carpano in 1786. Intensely herbal, vanilla-forward, with dried fruit and toffee. 23% ABV.

Tequila.name: Fortaleza Blanco
Tequila.description: 100% blue agave tequila from the Fortaleza distillery in Jalisco. Stone ovens and tahona wheel. Bright agave with pepper, citrus, and earth. Unaged, pure expression.

Amontillado sherry.name: Lustau Amontillado
Amontillado sherry.description: Amontillado sherry from Emilio Lustau in Jerez, Spain. Aged under flor then exposed to air. Nutty, dry, complex with hazelnut, brioche, and saline notes.

Cognac.name: Remy Martin VSOP
Cognac.description: Very Superior Old Pale cognac from Remy Martin. Blended from eaux-de-vie aged at least 4 years. Ripe stone fruit, vanilla, and toasted oak. Smooth and approachable.

Vodka.name: Belvedere Vodka
Vodka.description: Polish rye vodka from Belvedere. Quadruple distilled from Dankowskie rye. Creamy texture with white pepper, vanilla, and almond. 40% ABV.

Dry vermouth.name: Noilly Prat Original French Dry
Dry vermouth.description: Classic French dry vermouth from Noilly Prat in Marseillan. Macerated with herbs and spices from the Languedoc region. Herbal, bright, with chamomile and orange peel.

Prosecco.name: Nino Franco Rustico
Prosecco.description: Premium Prosecco from Nino Franco in Valdobbiadene. Glera grapes from historic vineyards. Fresh pear, white peach, and mineral notes. Dry finish.

Orange curaçao.name: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao
Orange curaçao.description: Premium dry curaçao from Pierre Ferrand in Cognac. Made from dried Caraçao oranges, cognac base, and sugar. Dry, bitter-orange profile with honey and spice.

White rum.name: Bacardi Superior
White rum.description: Iconic white rum from Bacardi, founded in Cuba in 1862. Light, smooth, and mixable with subtle vanilla and almond notes. The benchmark rum for Cuba Libre, Mojito, and Daiquiri.

Dark rum.name: Gosling's Black Seal
Dark rum.description: Bermudian dark rum from Gosling's. Rich molasses, toffee, and warm spice. Famous as the base of the Dark 'n' Stormy.

Overproof rum.name: Wray & Nephew Overproof
Overproof rum.description: Jamaican overproof white rum at 63% ABV. Intense ester-forward funk and alcohol heat. A dash is enough in Tiki drinks and flaming cocktails.

Gin.name: Hendrick's Gin
Gin.description: Scottish gin from William Grant & Sons. Infused with rose and cucumber. Silky, floral, and unusual. 41.4% ABV.

Geneva gin.name: Rutte Genever
Geneva gin.description: Dutch genever from Rutte Distillery. Malt-forward, malty, and rounded with juniper and citrus. Good bridge between whisky and gin.

Blanco tequila.name: Don Julio Blanco
Blanco tequila.description: 100% blue agave blanco tequila from Don Julio. Bright agave with pepper, citrus, and light pepper. Crisp and clean. 38% ABV.

Amaretto.name: Disaronno Amaretto
Amaretto.description: Italian amaretto liqueur from Saronno. Apricot kernel and almond character with sweet vanilla and cherry notes. 28% ABV.

Campari.name: Campari
Campari.description: Italian bitter aperitif from Milan. Intensely red, bitter, herbal with rhubarb, cherry, cinnamon, and citrus peel. 20.5% ABV.

Cherry liqueur.name: Luxardo Maraschino
Cherry liqueur.description: Premium Italian cherry liqueur from Marasca cherries. Complex with cherry, almond, spice, and herbal notes. 32% ABV.

Cointreau.name: Cointreau
Cointreau.description: Premium French triple sec. Clean orange flavor, 40% ABV, dry finish. The standard for classic cocktails.

Coffee liqueur.name: Kahlúa
Coffee liqueur.description: Mexican coffee liqueur from Veracruz. Sweet, dark, with strong coffee notes. 20% ABV.

Green crème de menthe.name: Marie Brizard Green Crème de Menthe
Green crème de menthe.description: Bright green mint crème liqueur. Sweet, minty, artificial-bright green color.

White crème de menthe.name: Marie Brizard White Crème de Menthe
White crème de menthe.description: Clear white mint crème liqueur. Same mint flavor as green but without artificial coloring.

Grenadine.name: Fee Brothers Grenadine
Grenadine.description: American grenadine from Fee Brothers. Deep red, sweet-tart pomegranate syrup-liqueur.

Drambuie.name: Drambuie
Drambuie.description: Scottish honey-herbal liqueur. Scotch whisky base with heather honey, herbs, and spices. 40% ABV.

Absinthe.name: Pernod Absinthe
Absinthe.description: French absinthe from Pernod Fils. High-proof anise-flavored spirit with wormwood, anise, and fennel. Turns cloudy with water. 68% ABV.

Angostura bitters.name: Angostura Aromatic Bitters
Angostura bitters.description: The iconic dash of bitters. Concentrated herbal extract with gentian root, spices, and herbs. Over 150 years old. 44.7% ABV.

Orange bitters.name: Regans' Orange Bitters No. 6
Orange bitters.description: Classic orange bitters from cocktail authority Gary Regan. Citrusy and aromatic. Lighter than Angostura.

Peychaud's bitters.name: Peychaud's Aromatic Bitters
Peychaud's bitters.description: New Orleans aromatic bitters. Anise, gentian, cherry. Distinctive red color. 35% ABV.

Fino sherry.name: Tio Pepe Fino
Fino sherry.description: Classic fino sherry from González Byass. Lightest, driest sherry style. Pale, saline, almond, and green apple.

Champagne.name: Moët & Chandon Brut Impérial
Champagne.description: Iconic Champagne from Moët & Chandon. Bright, lively, with green apple, citrus, and brioche. The standard for celebrations and French 75.

Irish cream.name: Baileys Irish Cream
Irish cream.description: Irish cream liqueur with Irish whiskey, cream, and chocolate. Smooth, sweet, 17% ABV.

Maraschino liqueur.name: Luxardo Maraschino
Maraschino liqueur.description: Premium Italian maraschino liqueur from Marasca cherry pits. Complex cherry, almond, spice. 32% ABV.

Triple sec.name: Cointreau
Triple sec.description: Premium French triple sec. Clean orange flavor, 40% ABV, dry finish. The standard for classic cocktails.

Heavy cream.name: Heavy cream
Heavy cream.description: High-fat dairy cream, usually 36–40% fat. Used for body and richness in shaken cocktails.

Simple syrup.name: Simple syrup
Simple syrup.description: Equal parts sugar and water, dissolved. The standard neutral sweetener for cocktails.

Orange liqueur.name: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao
Orange liqueur.description: Premium dry curaçao from Pierre Ferrand in Cognac. Dry, bitter-orange profile with honey and spice.
